capabilities: Explore linked notes on an interactive 3D star chart
Trace note provenance via the Provenance Lens
Collect cross-note passage selections in a shared tray
Chat with Clowder AI companions and save replies as pending notes
Export curated notes to an Obsidian Canvas
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.14.5+; mobile uncertified). UI uses Chinese labels with English command names. Chart, Lens, templates and local review work offline; chat and revision need the external instance. Drafts, quotes and failed messages are stored unencrypted in local data.json; no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian lists links but not the source paragraphs behind them, so tracing where a note's content came from and seeing its place in the vault is laborious.

relations.evidence: Connect a running Clowder AI instance to chat about selections
export notes to an Obsidian Canvas

summary: Visualizes linked notes as a 3D star chart with a Provenance Lens for link sources, plus optional AI chat and revision via a running Clowder AI instance.
